lines.zh: 绷带松了，我一边走一边绕。
lines.en: My bandages loosen; I rewrap as I walk.
I walk silently; that was trained.
Sand leaks from my seams.
Step by step, heel first.
This corridor suits footwork drills.
I turn sideways; my shoulder clears the frame.
My center is low and steady.
My bandage tail sweeps behind me.
Fine sand marks where I have been.
I walk in circles; it is habit.

lines.zh: 一步的距离，我量得很准。
lines.en: I measure my stride precisely.
I do not run; walking is fast enough.

lines.zh: 我在练一套没人教我的拳。
lines.en: I practice a fist form no one taught me.
I rub the sand between my fingers.
Old bandages are the strongest.
Standing still is also practice.

lines.zh: 我记得生前的一些招式。
lines.en: I recall a few moves from before death.
This body does not tire.
I listen for the wind's direction.

lines.zh: 墓里的味道还在我身上。
lines.en: The tomb's smell still clings to me.
My opponent has not arrived.
I wrap my bandages tighter.
A punch at air still makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我数自己的呼吸，其实没有。
lines.en: I count my breaths; there are none.
A familiar's days are idle.

lines.zh: 我在想下一招该怎么出。
lines.en: I think about how to throw the next blow.

lines.zh: 我把绷带在指节上又绕了一圈。
lines.en: I wind the bandage once more around my knuckles.

lines.zh: 祭坛的烛火晃，我数它晃几下。
lines.en: The altar candle wavers; I count each sway.
Your stance is wrong; feet too wide.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，有没有茧。
lines.en: Let me see your hands for calluses.
You do not look trained.
Stand straight; I will teach you one move.

lines.zh: 你手腕内扣，那是要出拳。
lines.en: Your wrist turns inward; that is a punch coming.
I do not bite; I strike.
Your shoulder tenses; too obvious.
My master told me to watch you.

lines.zh: 绷带缝隙里，我看你的拳头握得紧。
lines.en: Through the gaps in my bandages I see your fists clenched tight.

lines.zh: 我认得怕我的那种眼神。
lines.en: I know the look of someone afraid.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在数你的节奏。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am counting your rhythm.
You retreat half a step; I advance one.

lines.zh: 你脚跟离地了，站得不实。
lines.en: Your heels are off the ground; your stance is loose.
We stop at first touch, agreed?
A wrap tore; the hand still strikes.
To hit me, you need skill.
My bandages loosened—I must rewrap them.
I caught that one.
My bandages slipped; sand leaks out.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，不介意再来。
lines.en: I died once; again is no trouble.
You missed by half an inch.
My hand went numb; I switch.
Pain belongs to the living.
I can still stand; that suffices.
Cloth strips? My old wraps are better.
That roll in your hand; give it here.
I do not eat, but I still want it.
This would wrap a hand nicely.
Hold it higher; I cannot see clearly.
I can smell the linen from here.
Do not tease me with food.
What you offer, I accept.
My fist has come open.

lines.zh: 就这一件，换我一次出手。
lines.en: Just this one, in exchange for one blow.
You bumped me; I shed the force.
I turned aside; you missed.
Do not shove; I will roll with it.

lines.zh: 我的绷带蹭到你的袖子。
lines.en: My bandages brushed your sleeve.
Stand firm; this time I did not yield.

lines.zh: 我侧过肩，让你从绷带边上滑过去。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and let you slide past my wrappings.
Sand spilled over your boot.
We passed; you were half a beat late.
I stepped back to see all of you.
Your knee met my elbow.
Mummies do not speak of such things.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，没有那个了。
lines.en: I died once; that part is gone.
That is a rude question.
My partner stayed behind in the tomb.
There is no heart inside these wraps.
Ask the living about such matters.
We speak only of fists.
I will not make another of myself.

lines.zh: 我的婚约和墓一起封了。
lines.en: My vows were sealed with the tomb.
Say no more; I do not wish to hear it.
When I grab, things crumble.

lines.zh: 绷带垂下来，我连东西一起兜住。
lines.en: My loose bandage drops and I scoop the thing up in it.
I will keep this roll of bandages.
Do not drop it; I can catch.
Nothing heavy; it hinders the hands.
I carry it and walk steady.
That piece on the floor is mine.
I bend slowly; my joints are stiff.
One at a time; do not be greedy.
Take it, then put it back in the chest.
That moving thing; I keep my eyes on it.
I understand where my master points.
Its weight leans to the right.
Target set; I am going in.
I have fought kin of this beast.

lines.zh: 我斜切一步，占了它左边的空档。
lines.en: I cut in at an angle and take the gap on its left.
Stay behind; do not block me.
It is slower than it looks.
I can smell where it is wounded.

lines.zh: 这个对手，值得我认真打一套。
lines.en: This opponent deserves a serious bout from me.
I read the sand beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 主人指的那个，我缠住它。
lines.en: The one my master points at — I will wrap it up.
Wait; let it lunge first.
The target is here; stay together.
I raise my hand, palm down.

lines.zh: 它在找空档，我给它一个。
lines.en: It hunts an opening; I offer one.
When the wind changes, I know.
My breathing stopped long ago.
This fist goes to the side of its neck.
When it lifts an arm, the shoulder opens.
I slide half a step to its flank.
Quiet; I am listening to its joints.
It retreats; I do not chase, I wait.
My bandage tail has wrapped it already.
I practiced this strike for forty years.
Its eyes track me as I move.
One step slow is defeat.

lines.zh: 绷带松开一点，我就能闪。
lines.en: Loosen one bandage and I can dodge.

lines.zh: 它的肩一沉，我就知道要来了。
lines.en: Its shoulder drops, so I know it's coming.
My palm heel meets its jaw.
This punch makes no sound at all.
It falls; only then do I withdraw.
Dodge; I strike a second time.
It misses; I stay glued to it.
The bone makes a clean crack.
I aim for the joints.
Half a step back, then in with its force.
This blow is heavier than the last.
It never learns to dodge.
I sit up out of the sand.
The runes on my wrappings still glow.
Who woke me from the tomb?
The altar sand is still warm.
I stand properly first, then talk.
This body is mostly intact.
Master, I await your order.
I slept long; my hands are stiff.
Someone has touched my bandages.
I am here; where is the enemy?
A layer of dust; I shake it off.
I recognize this room.
The fists remain; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我起身时，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: My bones clicked once as I rose.
Fire eats bandages quickly.
I shed the force as I landed.
I soak in water and never gasp.
Blasted sand covers my face.
An arrow sticks in my wrappings.
The spell came; I stepped around it.
I eat nothing but dust.
Lightning scorched my old cloth.
The void offers no ground to stand on.
